Name: T's TV with Stand (Formerly TV with Stand (SDV1.6))
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Important Notice for Existing Users (Updating to v2.1)[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Starting with version 2.1, the mod's UniqueID, name, and file structure have changed.
If you're updating from a version earlier than 2.1, please delete the old "[b]TV with Stand (SDV1.6)[/b]" folder before installing the new version.
The item IDs for all TVs and catalogs have also changed in version 2.1. However, TVs and catalogs from previous versions that are already placed in the game or stored in your inventory or chests will be automatically migrated to the new IDs.
During this process, you may see ID migration messages in your SMAPI log. [b]These are normal informational messages, not errors.[/b]
Once the migration is complete, save your game. The migration messages will no longer appear when you load that save again.[/size][/quote]
[size=6][color=#ffff00][b]T's TV with Stand[/b][/color][/size]
Add a variety of TVs with stands designed to blend naturally with Stardew Valley's vanilla furniture!
Choose from different TV sizes and styles to match your farmhouse interior. Each TV features multiple stand designs that can be changed simply by rotating the furniture.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]
[b]Multiple TV Styles[/b]
Adds five types of TVs with stands, each available in Default, Black, and White color variants.
- TV with Stand
- Wide TV with Stand
- Plasma TV with Stand
- Panorama TV with Stand
- Mini TV with Stand

[b]Customizable TV Stands[/b]
While placing a TV, right-click to cycle through different stand designs before placing it.

[b]Panorama TV[/b]
Enjoy a wider TV screen with the Panorama TV, which supports displaying TV programs across its extra-wide screen.

[b]Mini TV with Table Function[/b]
The Mini TV can also function as a TV and table combination. Enable this feature in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to place items on the side of the stand without the TV.

[b]TV with Stand Catalog[/b]
Purchase the dedicated TV with Stand Catalog from Robin's shop to access all available TVs.

You can also purchase individual TVs directly from Robin's shop.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/color][/size]
Customize the mod through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].

- Enable or disable TV sales at Robin's shop.
- Choose which TV types and colors appear in the dedicated catalog.
- Adjust the catalog price.
- Change the Mini TV's screen position and enable its table function.
- Adjust texture saturation to better match recolor mods.

Hiding a TV from the catalog does not affect TVs you already own or have placed.

[b]Important:[/b] Remove any items placed on the Mini TV's stand before disabling its table function. Otherwise, those items may become inaccessible.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] 2.0.9 or later[/size]
Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is optional but recommended for changing settings in-game.

[size=5][color=#00ffff][b]Languages[/b][/color][/size]
Currently supports English and Japanese.
